Attached: 1 image

Ever wondered why #ApplePhotos  has been "still analysing" for three days, or why a keyword you added isn't searchable yet?

Photos Dashboard is an open source tool that shows exactly what geeky things your Mac's Photos app is doing: job queue, analysis progress, search index, and whether anything can run right now.

I vibecoded this in a few hours, so don't throw your main photos library at it without backing it up first.
https://github.com/gerardkieffer/photos-dashboard/

#macOS #Python #vibecoding #opensource
